The energy balance calculator successfully passed all verification tests with a perfect reward score, demonstrating a robust implementation of weighted risk logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.93 across one trial with zero exceptions. Pytest 8.4.1 confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite, validating the core calculation logic. Future iterations should maintain this weighting structure while ensuring that hardcoded campus energy constants remain configurable to avoid brittle assumptions.
